1.consolidated_definition: . Transitar, trajinar. “Cualquiera se cree —que es cosa feliz —estar traficando —de aquí para allí.” Pedro R. de Diego, , p. 45. (En español: trafagar, correr mundo).
1.en_consolidated_definition: To travel from place to place, to engage in itinerant activities; "anyone thinks that it is a happy thing to be trafficking - here and there." Pedro R. de Diego, p. 45 (in Spanish: trafagar, correr mundo).
